observations.summary: All household water leaves through one main drainage pipe into the septic tank; effluent then flows to the drainfield.
A single leaky or running toilet can add as much as 200 gallons per day; do not park or drive on the drainfield; plant trees an appropriate distance; only human waste and toilet paper in the toilet.
Average household leaks can waste more than 9,300 gallons a year; meter test over two hours; toilet dye test within 10 minutes.
Hours, free quotes and flat-rate pricing restated; all linked services exist under content/services.
observations.inference_limit: Only confirmed business facts are restated.
